#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /tmp/ocr
ls /tmp/scenes/*.png | split -n l/4 -d - /tmp/batch_
for batch in /tmp/batch_*; do
  (while read f; do
    out="/tmp/ocr/$(basename "$f" .png)"
    [ -f "${out}.txt" ] || tesseract "$f" "$out" 2>/dev/null
  done < "$batch") &
done
wait
echo "DONE"
EOF
